fields: CRU-11

K-SHAPE DISPERSION HOLDS, RATIO FORM. Over the window 2026-10-02 close through 2026-11-14 close (inclusive, trading sessions only), NCLH underperforms RCL on CUMULATIVE TOTAL RETURN from a frozen base by AT LEAST 5 percentage points at the window-close reading — i.e. NCLH_TR_cum − RCL_TR_cum ≤ -5pp at the 2026-11-14 close (or, if 11-14 is a non-trading session, the nearest preceding trading session close). SIX WQ-162 ELEMENTS. (1) Series: NCLH (NYSE:NCLH) and RCL (NYSE:RCL) daily closes from the repo-pinned Yahoo Finance pull (python .venv yfinance, download(auto_adjust=False)["Adj Close"]) with FORGE/tools/market-data/fetch.py as the cross-check at window close only — same source family as CRU-05, WQ-215, WQ-222. (2) Window: 2026-10-02 close (base) through 2026-11-14 close inclusive; 30 trading sessions. (3) Price type: ADJUSTED daily closes (total return — dividend reinvested on the ex-date, from yfinance Adj Close) — WQ-215 / WQ-222 basis, same as VX-CRU-06 and the superseded VX-CRU-06 total-return re-cut. (4) Sampling rule: every in-window trading session close; grade on the single window-close reading (persistence reading, not path-max — same as CRU-05). (5) Basis: cumulative total return of each name from its own 2026-10-02 close, measured in pp: TR_cum_i(t) = AdjClose_i(t)/AdjClose_i(2026-10-02) − 1, expressed in pp. The quantity graded is NCLH_TR_cum(window_close) − RCL_TR_cum(window_close) in pp. (6) Resolver: ≤ -5pp = CONFIRMED (dispersion holds); > -5pp = FAILED (dispersion closes); window-close reading unreadable from both pinned sources (yfinance AND fetch.py both return no close for NCLH or RCL for a session that was traded) = NO-VERDICT, not FAILED. ⛔ DISTINCT FROM VX-CRU-06: VX-CRU-06 grades CCL-over-RCL excess drawdown through the 2026-09-29 CCL Q3 print; CRU-11 grades NCLH-over-RCL excess drawdown through 2026-11-14 — different pair (fragile vs premium, not high-cost vs premium), different window (post-print forward test, not pre-print). ⛔ NO ANTECEDENT: CRU-05 was theater-conditional, which left it exposed to common-mode fuel/theater relief; the ratio form is common-mode-immune by construction, so no fuel/theater antecedent is needed to protect it. The K-shape thesis is what is being tested, directly.

STATUS 2026-10-01 window-close snapshots were NCLH 4.12 and RCL 45.81 (9/18 closes, not current); current prices to be pulled at the first in-window close. ⛔ NO FREE PARAMETER AFTER SEEING DATA: window end, series source, basis, sampling and threshold are all frozen in this cell at registration. A later edit to any one is a NEW row, never an amendment (CRU-09 precedent). ⚠️ KNOWN TAIL-RISK: NCLH announces a buyback or similar return of capital inside the window, which can tighten its spread to RCL without any K-shape convergence; this is not re-tuned out — it is a legitimate way for the dispersion to close, and the row grades the SPREAD, not the mechanism. ⚠️ SECOND KNOWN RISK: a Big-3 M&A event or a NCLH-specific event flips both legs — resolver NO-VERDICT clause does NOT cover that; it covers only unreadable closes.
